content: GOAL: rank the 5 proposals under rank-2026-10-v1. READ: the frozen evidence bundles inline for QPEX-CURVBIAS (c0d55832), EQVOTE-HYP-RQ (c71aaa7b), CURVQUOTA-SWAP-SID (46d74349), geopull-exactquota (6ea5e65b), QUOTAPERM-HYP (4f6c451e). OBSERVED: all five bundles share the same observed core (E5 successor-entropy stratification, E6 width-20 beam survival, E7 teacher-forced NLL, E8 first-level capacity ceiling, E9 cohort-profile signal, E10 transition stats, E11 same_first_prefix_rate 0.0907 vs null 0.067). Differences are only in the PROPOSED E1/E2/E3/E12/E13 fields, which are the proposals' own claims and not measurements. OPEN: check working dir for any supplementary evidence files before finalising.

FINAL ANSWER (rubric rank-2026-10-v1). Evidence basis: all five bundles share an identical observed core, so placements rest on policy compliance (derived vs undefined constants), which measured failure each mechanism closes, which level it acts on, and similarity to the measured hyperbolic arms. Decisive: E6 successor_geodesic_coarse 0.05500 / v2 0.05463 / tangent_successor_residual 0.05500 ~= baseline 0.055537, while l1_br_euclid 0.06207 / l1_only 0.06233 / resample 0.06363 beat it; E7 wins come from high T1 entropy and near-deterministic T4 (resample 4.55/3.82/0.73/0.05) vs l1_br dumping all entropy at T4 (0/0/0/9.03); E8 K=256 first-level ceiling 0.0822 vs E11 baseline same_first_prefix 0.0907; E5 top-1 mass 0.4375 vs 0.0543 across entropy quintiles.

RANK: QPEX-CURVBIAS | position=1 | reason=Only proposal whose margin-calibrated additive bias is guaranteed to reorder the top-1 (answering the 0-of-4-argmin round-2 no-op) while swap-exact quotas hold the Euclidean per-level histograms so the round-1 170->56 collapse cannot recur; derived delta=[-0.328,-0.071,+0.399] disperses level 1 and concentrates level 3, matching the only arms above baseline (resample T1/T4 NLL 4.55/0.05, recall 0.06363; l1_br_euclid 0.06207) and avoiding the successor-geodesic family measured at 0.05500.
RANK: CURVQUOTA-SWAP-SID | position=2 | reason=Acts at all three levels with per-item successor mass times per-edge standardised curvature plus exact 2-swap quotas, the strongest per-item behaviour-by-geometry coupling that cannot move usage counts (E11 0.0907); but its own risk concedes the bias (0.1-0.4 vs distance spread ~1) may not move items, eta_2=-0.24 leaves the level-2 bottleneck (E6 depth-2 survival 0.829) inert, m_l is undefined, and its curved commitment plus tangent-space EMA reopens the round-1 codebook risk.
RANK: QUOTAPERM-HYP | position=3 | reason=Safest of the five: conserving the whole triple bag (247/7414/20223, 0.177 collision) makes collapse algebraically impossible and it re-pairs items to triples at all levels with scale-free rank fusion; but an ordinal rank-sum over a 32-candidate set with undefined B_i can easily be a near-no-op, it never touches Stage 2 so the E8 first-level ceiling (K=256 0.0822 vs 0.0907 baseline) stays binding, and no measured arm supports a post-hoc permutation.
RANK: EQVOTE-HYP-RQ | position=4 | reason=Clean bounded additive vote with derived lambda and quota-exact transpositions, but the measured sign gate (delta_3=+0.399 only) confines it to level 3, leaving the level-1 lever that produced the largest measured gain (l1_br 0.04671 -> l1_br_euclid 0.06207) untouched; it is the closest analogue of tangent_successor_residual, measured at exactly the 0.05500 baseline, and its risk 4 concedes the Poincare kernel may be Euclidean-equivalent.
RANK: geopull-exactquota | position=5 | reason=Most aggressive per-item geodesic construction, but its deferred-acceptance solve never states code-side preferences and lambda_l is undefined, failing the minimal-specification clause; the 0.05 flip trigger with a 30-refresh cap freezes an early-epoch assignment for most of the 3000 epochs, it concedes stable-not-optimal matching can degrade reconstruction, and it is the same successor-geodesic family measured at 0.05500/0.05463.
